children: Canada office property REIT's Q3 rental revenue declined yr/yr amid Trio property sale
Q3 adjusted funds from operations remained negative, reflecting low occupancy and higher borrowing costs
Company advancing asset sales under its Asset Recycling Plan to manage debt and address property challenges
Company expects sale of Arcueil property to close in Q1 2027, subject to appeal period
Company anticipates Delizy property sale to close in Q3 2027, subject to permit and tenant eviction
Company says refinancing risk is material as significant debt matures within 12 months
TRIO PROPERTY SALE - Net rental income declined mainly due to the sale of the Trio property, with partial offset from the absence of the vacant Baldi property
LOW OCCUPANCY - Persistently low occupancy rates across the portfolio contributed to weak rental income and negative adjusted funds from operations
HIGHER BORROWING COSTS - Increased borrowing costs weighed on results, with a higher weighted average interest rate and significant variable-rate debt exposure
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "hold"
The average consensus recommendation for the commercial reits peer group is "hold"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Inovalis Real Estate Investment Trust is C$0.85, about 70% above its November 12 closing price of C$0.50
